Dialogs.Dialog: ▲Kobayaka＊▲！？
When did you grow up so much!? And that apron is...
Kobayakawa
Because... I'm your wife. Of course I've grown up, and of course I wear an apron.
My wife!? You mean we are married!?
You're such a weird guy... Hey, are you still half asleep？ If you don't hurry, you will be late for work.
Oh no！ I'm late！ Then I'm leaving！
Darliiing！
W-What is it？
What do you want to eat for your dinner？
I'm in a hurry！ We don't have to talk about that now.
No！ It's the duty of a wife to cook delicious food for her husband.
What do you want for dinner tonight？ Japanese food？ Western？ Or Chinese？ Or...
Anything's fine！ Can't you decide that much yourself!?
(*Shock*！)
R-Right. I'm a useless woman who can't even plan dinner on her own... I'm a failure as your wife！
Don't exaggerate！
Then you won't hate me？ You still love me？
I don't hate you and I still love you！
Rinko is happy！
You're okay now, right？ I'll get going.
Geez！ You forgot your wedding ring！ You're so scatterbrained...
Ring!? Oh, but I'm in such a hurry today！
There must be another woman！ ...And I'm doomed to be thrown out on Thursday, burnable trash day, aren't I!?
I won't throw you out, I won't！ Okay, I'll wear the ring！
Really？ Rinko is happy！
I'm already late, so I have to leave now.
Darliiing！
What is it this time!?
Aren't you forgetting your goodbye kiss？
Kiss!?
You do it every morning. Come on, chu～
W-Wait！ Look, I have to get to work...！
As I thought...！ You don't love me anymore...
I love you！ I love you, so please let me go to work!!
Really!? Then will you say "I love you" a million times, right now？
I love you... (Still 999,999 times left.)
I love you... (Still 999,998 times left.)
I love you... (Still 999,997 times left.)
I love you... (Still 999,996 times left.)
I love you... (Still 999,995 times left.)
Argh, cut it out!!
Ta-da♪
I love you... I love you... I love you...
Phew... Finally up to number 965,730...
Hm...？ ...Oh, it was a dream. Newlywed life isn't so bad... maybe？
("I love you！" a million times, huh...)
ＨＩＮＴ
Say "I love you！" into the microphone
Hmm...？ ▲小早川＊▲!?
Kobayakawa
Ah, you finally came to.
Hmm... Huh？ By the way, where are we!?
Where？ A deserted island, obviously.
D-Deserted island!? How did we end up here？
In the end, the only people who washed ashore on this island are you and Rinko...
Just the two of us on this deserted island!?
Some unknown cosmic ray, or germs leaked from a lab... It turned into a stupid plot straight out of a movie...
So you mean there are unusual phenomena all around the world？
Yeah... In the end, you and Rinko are the only ones left alive in this world...
Just the two of us!? What do we do from now on...？
Sorry... It's Rinko's fault...
▲小早川＊▲'s fault？ What do you mean!?
This is the world that Rinko wished for...
Why did you wish for this kind of world...？
No one ever accepted me... No one ever understood me... I always thought I was all alone.
So I asked God... if he wanted me alone that badly, then at least make it so I wouldn't feel lonely.
And the world turned out like this. If everyone vanished, there'd be no one to feel lonely about, right？
God must have punished me for making that kind of wish.
Just because you became my boyfriend, you got punished along with me. I'm sorry...
God didn't punish you... After all, he didn't leave ▲小早川＊▲ alone, did he？
He entrusted this world to us... I'm sure of it.
From now on it's just the two of us, so we have to work together to survive！
I see... But Rinko's not lonely anymore, okay？ Because you're here...
Let's do our best to live. We'll pass our lives on to future generations！
A dream？ The world with just ▲小早川＊▲ and me, huh...？
Kobayakawa
Meow... Meow...
An abandoned cat？ ...No, it's ▲小早川＊▲!?
Meow, meow！
What happened!? Why are you...
Meow～...
Sorry, I don't understand what you're saying...
Meow, meow, meow！
You want me to play with you？
Meow～♪
Then let's do our usual touchy-feely routine！
Kyaaa！
Oh... She seems to hate this...
Hissss！
Not the tail, huh...？
Meow...！
I think that's her weak spot...
Purrrr...
Hahaha, in a good mood, huh？
Are these whiskers real？
Meow～！
Oh, cool！
They really stretch...
Kyaaa～！
Sorry！ Did it hurt...？
That's enough！
She talked!?
Rinko the kitten was so cute...
(Those paw pads... Maybe I'll try touching them？)
(Are those ears real？ Now I'm curious...)
(Since she's a cat, will she get wary if I touch her tail？)
(Cats purr when you scratch their chin... right？)
(Will she get mad if I touch these whiskers？)
ＨＩＮＴ
Touch her paw pads
Touch her ears
Touch her tail
Touch her chin
Pull her whiskers
Rinko
Lucky Magical～♪ Lucky Magical Girl Rinko is here to make your life better！
▲小早川＊▲!? What's wrong？ Why are you dressed like that!?
Don't you know？ This "Lucky Magical Girl Rinko" is a very popular show on TV！
Lucky Magical Girl Rinko？ It's some sort of a magical girl show？
Yeah, that's right.
I see... And that must be the magical wand！
Hm？ Oh... this is a club.
I beat the bad guys to a pulp with it！
A club...？ Ow！ Ow ow...
I'll beat you black and blue！
I-It hurts！ Stop it！
Well, it's something like that.
...What's with that？ Don't you transform with it or something？ Shoot heart- or star-shaped beams...
Transform？ As if I could do that. I just change clothes like a normal person.
Changed your clothes？ So this is just a cosplay？
Cosplay？ Do I look like someone who would do that kind of thing？
Well, you don't.
What's that heart-shaped thing？
The Cutie Koban.
Hmm？ What do you use it for？
Hmm... Rinko doesn't really know either. Some big shot, a "spon-sor"？ told me to carry it.
(So it's a toy tie-in for little girls...)
What's that necklace with a bell on it？
When this thing shines, I'll know that someone is calling for me.
But it's shining now. Don't you have to go？
I'll just skip it... I feel kind of sluggish today.
Is it okay like that!?
Ah... Don't touch my costume. It's a rental item.
It's not even yours...
By the way, since you're a magical girl, don't you have that thing... I mean, that tiny animal as your sidekick？
Nope. It's low budget, so they probably skimped.
Really？ Then what's that peeking in from the left side of the screen？
Huh...？
Hey, there is one！ Huh... a daruma. That's a fresh concept.
That's my dad.
Y-Your dad!?
Daruma
Indeed. I am Lucky Magical Girl Rinko's father.
So sorry, sir！ Rinko-san always takes such good care of me!!
Hmm！ Hmmmm!? It's you！ You're the punk who drags Rinko around till all hours!!
Yes, this guy is Rinko's boyfriend.
Drag her around!? Not at all...
Outrageous！ I will never forgive a punk who leads my daughter astray！
Rinko！ Punish him with that thing！
Okaaay！
My dad is angry now, so just bear with this beam for a bit, okay？
W-What!? What beam？
Lucky Magical～♪
Nooooooooooooo！ P-Please forgive me!!
Urgh... Well, of course, it was just a dream...
Still, that show's getting canceled after one season, guaranteed.
(That outfit really screams "magical girl！")
(The bell around her neck is shining...)
(What on earth is that heart-shaped thing for？)
ＨＩＮＴ
Touch her costume
Touch the bell
Touch the Cutie Koban
▲小早川＊▲？ You got really small, huh？
Kobayakawa
Um, you're wearing such cute clothes, huh？
(Urgh... She doesn't talk to me.)
Did your Mama tie the ribbons for you？
(This is no good... I should find a topic to talk with her about...)
(Not that, huh...)
That's a cute doll.
...Yeah.
(Oh！ She's speaking to me now！)
What is her name？
...Emily-chan.
Let's be friends, Emily-chan！
She says... okay.
Then we're friends！ You'll be my friend too, right, Rinko-chan？
(Oops！ What did I do wrong？)
Emily-chan says, "Let's play house？"
Oh, sure. Let's play！
Then Rinko will be Mama.
I will be Papa then.
Okay, fine...
Then let's start from when Papa comes home from work, okay？
No. Papa is always busy with work. Papa doesn't come home.
I see. But today Papa finished work early, so Papa is coming home.
...Yeah. Fine by me？
Here we go～. *Click*... I'm home～.
My！ You're home early？ It'll probably rain tomorrow！
Hahaha...
Ahem, let's try that again. *Click*... I'm home～.
Welcome home, darling. Will it be "nerdin" first？ Or an "ershow"？
("Nerdin"？ "Ershow"？)
What's "nerdin"？ Papa doesn't get it...？
Dunno. When Rinko's papa comes home, he always says, "Is nerdin ready yet？"
I see... I don't know what it is, but I guess I'll have nerdin.
Sorry. I didn't know that you would be home early. I didn't prepare it for you.
Ahaha... No nerdin for Papa today, huh？
Oh, and pay back the "C-ten-G thou" I lent you the other day.
("C-ten-G thou"？)
You said you needed it 'cause you ate shisu in Zagin and took a xitaxi home from Giroppon, remember？
？？？？？ Rinko-chan's family sure talks in a very mysterious way, huh？
No, just Papa. He's probably not Japanese.
Really？
...Rinko hates Papa！
Papa would be sad if you said that, you know？
It's fine！ Papa treats Mama badly！ That's why Rinko hates him！
But Rinko loves Mama！
And this outfit... Mama made it, you know？ It looks the same as Emily-chan's. Hehe...
Wow, it really suits you. Your mama's really kind, huh？
Yes！ Mama is very good at making clothes！
She says she'll even make Rinko's wedding dress when Rinko gets married！
I see... She must be looking forward to seeing Rinko-chan as a bride.
Yup！
Maybe ▲小早川＊▲...
Maybe she's lived her whole life feeling lonely...
(She's holding onto that doll like it's really precious...)
ＨＩＮＴ
Touch the doll
？ Where is this...？
That girl with the white hat... Somehow, she looks transparent...
Girl
I've been looking for you.
Did you finally come to get me？
But we've never met before？
No, your memories are just a little jumbled right now. Here, take a breath...？
This smells like... Lavender？
Yes... You'll remember.
But I don't even know where this place is...
This is a memory inside your head. A special place where the clock hands turn backward...
Wait a minute...
Hehe... Ah... Hey！ Can you see it？
That summer, under the blue sky, we played by the river. We walked in the sunflower fields. We listened to cicadas cry.
I feel like I have forgotten something...
Yeah. ...You're okay now. I have to go...
I see... I will remember you forever.
You don't have to remember me. Just... if you'd think of me sometimes...
Kobayakawa
But... if you really can't figure it out, ask the lavender, okay？
Eh？
Ask it lavender's flower meaning！ Hmph！
Lavender's flower meaning: "I am waiting for you."
"I am waiting for you," huh...
I think she's okay now, but I'll make sure ▲小早川＊▲ never feels lonely again.
Gaaah！ Death Genome！ They have planned to invade the Earth... Argh... They've come this far...！
Arggggggghhhhh！
W-What is that robot!?
Kobayakawa
Everyone in the Earth Defense Force, from here on, just leave it to me！
Y-You are Rintaro！ Hah！ ...Could that be...
Volvavin... I can't believe the prototype was already complete！
Stand up, Volvavin！
Grrrrrrr！
All right！ Let's go！
Take this！ Volve Kick～!!
Yes!! The Volve Kick！ How's that, Death Genome!?
Whooooosh...
Ahhhhhhhhh!!
What was that...!? The Volve Kick couldn't do anything to him！
Whooooosssshhhh！
Waaaaaah！
Ah！ Volvavin!!
Urgh...
Volvavi～～nnn!!
What's wrong!? Move！ Move now！
What is that!? Now, Volvavin can't move！
So it really was too soon for actual combat...
Waaaaaaaaah!!
Rintaro-kun！ It's too dangerous. You must leave Volvavin now!!
I won't let go... I won't let go... I won't let goooo！
Mother
(Rintaro...)
(Rintaro... Open your eyes.)
Mom...！
(Now... We shall join forces to bring down Death Genome！)
Yes！
(Now is the time I shall grant you my power... Now, shout "Volve Fusion"！)
Volve Fusion～～～!!
Grrrrrrrrrr！
I can feel it...！ Rintaro-kun and Volvavin are now synchronized！
Right！ The Super Robot Warrior Volvavin was built with the DNA of Rintaro-kun's mother.
A mother's heart, desperate to protect her son, fused them together！
Now！ Volvavin！
Volve Missiles!!
You did it！ Volvavin！ Rintaro-kun！
We did it... Mom！
...Thanks, Volvavin！
Volve Fusion～～～～!! Yes！ Volvavin is the best...
Kobayakawa
...Hey, are you listening？
Eh？
...Did you fall asleep？
Sorry.
Hah... Are you fully awake now？
Yeah, perfect.
Then, back to what I was saying... Maybe the world we're living in and feeling right now is just a dream...
...But I'm seeing and feeling ▲小早川＊▲ right here, right now.
If I reach out my hand, I can touch you. This feeling tells me that it's real.
But the feeling you mentioned is just a perception of your brain. What if your brain is also dreaming...？
That's...
There's no guarantee. No one really knows whether they're awake or dreaming right now...
Dreams are images your subconscious creates, things you "want" to see.
What do you mean？
In other words...
Maybe Rinko, living happily with you like this, is just an image Rinko's subconscious created.
No way...
It's a world born from that ideal... Maybe that's why you're this close, and Rinko can be this happy.
'Cause in a dream, anything goes.
Even when Rinko's selfish, you just laugh and forgive her... Maybe Rinko wished for a wonderful world like that.
That's because I want to.
Is that what you want？
Yeah. Putting up with ▲小早川＊▲'s selfishness makes me happy.
Hehe.
Hm？
So if the world where you feel happy... is a dream your subconscious created...
Ah...
(Ugh, I'm losing track... So sleepy...)
What？ Are you going to sleep again？
Yeah, sorry... I can't...
Hope you have a good dream...
Rinko had a dream today too... a dream where she was with you...
The sun behind you was shining so brightly...
A really long tube came hanging down from that sun...
Then it lifted up, and wind came blasting out...
Rinko could barely stand...
...I fell asleep while talking to ▲小早川＊▲ again, eh？
Which means this is a dream... a lucid dream...？
My room, the feel of my pillow... it's all so real...
Wait, no！ That was the dream, and this is reality... right？
Finally, it's down to the last leaf.
Kobayakawa
Eh!?
That bare tree... Its leaves keep falling... just like my life.
Talk like that and you really won't get better.
▲小早川＊▲... It's true. I'm in pretty bad shape.
Liar, I can't hear you. I don't believe it.
When I was admitted, that tree was lush and green. Now it's using the last of its strength.
You'll get better. They gave you new medicine, right？
Changing medicine won't help. It's just a painkiller. There's no cure.
You'll get better, I'm telling you！ If you lose heart, the illness will win.
You're kind, ▲小早川＊▲. But I know. I don't have much longer.
But... when I'm gone, how many people will shed a tear...？
Rinko will cry. Because Rinko... will love you forever and ever.
You're only saying that because you know I don't have long.
Of course I mean it！ You're the most precious person in the world...
That's why... Don't leave Rinko alone！
I'm so happy. But I don't have much time left.
I beg you. Don't say such things！ I will do anything for you！ I will ask any doctor to come and cure you！ So...
▲小早川＊▲, you're still young. You have to fall in love lots and enjoy your life.
No... It has to be you, or Rinko doesn't want anyone...！
I am so glad that I have ▲小早川＊▲ here by my side in my final moment... I can go peacefully while holding your warm hands...
I'll never forgive you if you die. So... don't say things like that.
Heh... You're as selfish as ever, ▲小早川＊▲.
Yeah. 'Cause Rinko's selfish... Rinko believes you'll get better... She won't give up...
▲小早川＊▲, look at me.
Come on, stop crying.
I can't stand the thought of you being gone...
...You finally stopped crying.
...Yeah.
I'm glad I met ▲小早川＊▲. Those memories mean I'm not afraid of anything anymore.
▲小早川＊▲... Don't lose heart even after I'm gone. Promise me.
You'll promise, right？ That you'll always stay the honest, straightforward ▲小早川＊▲.
...I'm so glad. ...This way... I can leave peacefully...
Ah, the last leaf has finally been blown away by the wind... Goodbye, ▲小早川＊▲...
▲小早川＊▲... Thank you.
No～～！
*sniff* *sniff* ▲小早川＊▲... Goodbye...
*sniff* ...Eh？ What's with these tears!?
Maybe I've been run-down lately...
(She's crying... I have to wipe away her tears.)
ＨＩＮＴ
Wipe away her tears
(Today is ▲小早川＊▲'s first live show...)
(Finally, ▲小早川＊▲'s dream came true...)
(▲小早川＊▲ as a member of the Killer Bambies...！)
Kobayakawa
Make some noise！
More！
More!!
Yeahhh！
Phew...
Good evening, we are the Killer Bambies.
(Great！ It's so great... ▲小早川＊▲！)
Um... What to say...
Ah, yeah...
First... thanks to all of you who came out tonight.
And then... to the God of the Deth Jabbi...
To the one who gave a worthless girl like me a reason to live... my worst possible thanks...
Tonight, I'm giving it everything until I drop...
And then... I dunno anymore...
You didn't come here to listen to me talk, right？
Okay.
My name is Rinko.
The Killer Bambies' Rinko.
Stick with me to the ends of hell...
(Even though I'm watching her from the front row...)
(I don't know why the stage seems to be so far away...)
(▲小早川＊▲... She just seems to be far away...)
(Did she just look this way？)
(It's all right...)
(We are always connected to each other...)
(Distance, status... none of it matters...)
(We're... one, right？)
I love you！
Yeahhh～!!
...Eh？ A dream？
▲小早川＊▲ in my dream was shining...
(Things are really heating up！ "Yeah!!")
ＨＩＮＴ
Shout "Yeah!!" into the microphone
